title: The Stepfather
description: A Pacific Northwest teen (Jill Schoelen) suspects that her mother's (Shelley Hack) smiling new husband (Terry O'Quinn) is not what he appears to be.

title: Silent Night, Deadly Night Part 2
description: The younger sibling of the teenager who killed while dressed as Santa carries on in his brother's bloody footsteps.

title: The Heart of Me
description: A woman (Helena Bonham Carter) has an affair with her older sister's (Olivia Williams) husband (Paul Bettany) and bears his child.

title: The Decline of Western Civilization Part II: The Metal Years
description: Filmmaker Penelope Spheeris scans the heavy-metal music scene: Alice Cooper, Lizzy Borden, Poison, Aerosmith, Kiss, Ozzy Osbourne.

title: Alligator
description: A herpetologist helps a detective track her flushed-away pet, now a king-size mutant called Ramone.

title: Infernal Affairs II
description: In this prequel to the original, a rebel policeman sets up the infiltration of Triad gangs and tries to bring down a corrupt cop working for the Triad boss.

title: Raise the Titanic
description: A U.S. admiral (Jason Robards) and his team (Richard Jordan, David Selby) compete with Russians in an attempt to salvage the luxury liner.

title: A Fantastic Fear of Everything
description: Becoming paranoid after his research into serial killers, a writer (Simon Pegg) must confront his numerous demons in order to make it to an important meeting about his screenplay.

title: College
description: To impress his sweetheart (Anne Cornwall), a bookworm (Buster Keaton) goes out for baseball and crew.

title: Piranha
description: Two people (Bradford Dillman, Heather Menzies) unwittingly free a mad military scientist's (Kevin McCarthy) mutant fish near a summer camp and resort lake.

title: A Midnight Clear
description: A young GI (Ethan Hawke) and his squad have a strange encounter with Germans in the Ardennes forest, December 1944.

title: Take Back
description: A woman embarks on a vengeful quest to save her kidnapped daughter from a mysterious man from her past.

title: Knight of Cups
description: A Los Angeles screenwriter (Christian Bale) indulges his wild side with a stripper (Teresa Palmer), a model (Freida Pinto) and a married woman (Natalie Portman).

title: The Kid
description: The Little Tramp (Charlie Chaplin) raises the abandoned child (Jack Coogan) of an unwed mother (Edna Purviance).

title: The Decline of Western Civilization
description: Director Penelope Spheeris surveys the late-1970s Los Angeles punk scene: X, Black Flag, Fear, Germs, Catholic Discipline, Alice Bag Band.

title: The Getaway
description: An explosives-expert thief (Alec Baldwin) and his wife (Kim Basinger) cross a crime lord and are chased to the Mexican border.

title: Silent Hill: Revelation
description: When her adoptive father disappears, Sharon Da Silva is drawn into a strange and terrifying alternate reality that holds answers to the horrific nightmares that have plagued her since childhood.

title: The Ticket
description: After a sightless man suddenly regains his vision, he is blinded by his obsession with the superficial.

title: Jesus of Nazareth
description: Jesus' teachings and miracles draw large crowds.

title: The Man With the Golden Arm
description: A dried-out heroin addict (Frank Sinatra) returns to his wife (Eleanor Parker) and card dealing in Chicago.

title: An Eye for an Eye
description: A San Francisco policeman (Chuck Norris) quits the force to avenge his partner's murder by Asian drug dealers.

title: Chopper
description: A maximum security inmate (Eric Bana), serving time for kidnapping a judge, becomes a target when he stabs another prisoner.

title: The Gambler III: The Legend Continues
description:
S01 E01
An Old West poker player, his partner and a schoolmarm help Dakota Indians thwart a senator's land-grab.

title: The Little Hours
description: A young servant fleeing from his master takes refuge at a dysfunctional convent in medieval Tuscany, disguising himself as a deaf-mute.

title: Filly Brown
description: Majo Tonorio (Gina Rodriguez), a talented hip-hop artist, is offered a record deal from a sleazy producer. She faces a difficult choice between selling out for money or staying true to herself and her music.

title: Abduction
description: A man steps out of a fountain in a park in Ho Chi Minh City with no memory of who he is. He wanders the city trying to piece together his past while being pursued by mysterious figures.

title: Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
description: While visiting an excavation site in Kenya, a former priest sees signs of demonic possession.

title: Starcrash
description: A space explorer and his girlfriend try to protect Earth from devastation.

title: The Kill Room
description: A hit man teams up with an art dealer for a money-laundering scheme that unwittingly turns him into an avant-garde sensation.

title: Fifty Shades of Black
description: In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," wealthy entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) introduces a young woman (Kali Hawk) to his kinky world of S&M.

title: House on Haunted Hill
description: The owner of a haunted mansion offers a group of people reward money if they can survive a night at his scary estate.

title: Suburbia
description: An overwhelming sense of despair impels a teenager to leave his suburban home and join up with a group of punk rockers.

title: The Pledge
description: A detective about to retire promises a woman to catch her daughter's murderer.

title: Stay Cool
description: A successful author (Mark Polish) reunites with a high-school beauty (Winona Ryder) when he returns to his hometown.

title: Jesus of Nazareth
description: After Joseph and Mary's betrothal, Mary is visited by the angel Gabriel, who tells her she will bear the Son of God; Mary and Joseph travel to Bethlehem to take part in Herod's census, where Jesus is born.

title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
description: King Arthur (Graham Chapman) goes questing on a pretend horse, followed by his lackey clacking coconut shells.

title: The Tai Chi Master
description: Two Shaolin Temple pupils (Jet Li, Chin Siu-hou) take different life paths, leading to an ultimate battle between them.

title: Side Effects
description: A woman's (Rooney Mara) world unravels after her psychiatrist (Jude Law) prescribes a new medication to treat her anxiety.

title: Guns of Redemption
description: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel.

title: Homeboy
description: A low-life boxer (Mickey Rourke) hits town for a fight and meets a two-bit hood (Christopher Walken) who tries to lure him into a robbery.

title: The Dark Crystal
description: Two elfin beings search for the missing shard to an all-powerful crystal that can save their world from evil.

title: The Commitments
description: An Irish hustler (Robert Arkins) puts together a Dublin band that covers hits of 1960s American soul.
